audit_items.proof_trace: Uniqueness is enforced at two layers: (1) application-level check at L1100-1109 queries `attendance.users` for the normalized `card_id` and rejects if it belongs to a different user; (2) DB-level `UNIQUE` constraint on `attendance.users.card_id` (migration `0001_create_attendance_schema.sql:18`) acts as a hard backstop catching any TOCTOU race. The same normalized value is used in both the check and the update, preventing bypass via encoding variation.
